info.name: ALTR Datastore Information Service Data Tagging API

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters search string on tag source, tag name or tag value, default no filter.

params.name: dataTagGroupID
params.description: Filters search string on the data tags group ID, default no filter.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all tags found for a client to empower locks/thresholds decisions.

info.name: Retrieve list of ALTR Group Tags.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters search string on tag name property, default no filter.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all tag groupings found for a client to empower locks/thresholds decisions. If a tag has many values, this will return the higher level tag names de-duped.

info.name: Retrieve tagged column information for a tag-id.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Comes from the tag-id returned from the tags/v1/tags/list endpoint to get more details on specific tags.

items.docs: Retrieves if a tag-id is valid, and gets a list of relevant details

info.name: Delete tag information for a tag-id.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Comes from the tag-id returned from the tags/v1/tags/list endpoint to get more details on specific tags.

items.docs: Deletes a tag-id if it is valid

params.name: tagGroupID
params.description: Comes from the tag-group-id returned from the tags/v1/tags/groups/list endpoint to get more details on specific tag groupings.

items.docs: Retrieves if a tag-group-id is valid, and gets a list of relevant details

info.name: Delete a tag group and tags within the group

params.name: tagGroupID
params.description: Comes from the tag-group-id returned from the tags/v1/tags/groups/list endpoint to get more details on specific tags.

items.docs: Delete tag group information for a tag-id, as well as all corresponding tag values within the group.

info.name: Retrieves list of columns associated to tags.

params.name: tagId
params.description: Comes from the tag-id returned from the tags/v1/tags/list endpoint to get more details columns associated with the tag.

params.name: isActive
params.description: True returns only actively tagged columns, false returns historical list of columns that have ever been associated to the tag.

items.docs: Returns list of columns associated to tags.
